description: This file defines the LeaveAssignmentService class, which is responsible for handling leave assignment logic within the Leave plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It manages assigning leave requests, checking leave overlaps, validating leave periods, creating leave requests, and dispatching related events.

classes.name: LeaveAssignmentService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing leave assignment logic, including creating leave requests, validation, and event dispatching.

methods.name: assignLeave
methods.description: Handles the process of assigning leave by validating the leave period, overlaps, shift length, and then saving the leave request.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Creates and saves a leave request, handles entitlement checks, comments, and dispatches leave assignment events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the leave status based on whether the date is a weekend, holiday, or a regular working day, and applies workflow logic.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether exceeding leave balance is permitted; here it always returns true.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForAssignAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow item related to the 'ASSIGN' action for leave approval workflow.
